description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Accuracy@1 on geometry problems, specifically those from Geomverse, and tree width. The x-axis is labeled “Tree width” and uses a linear scale ranging from 6 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A single blue line with circular markers is present, beginning at approximately 19.4 when tree width is 6.5, increasing to 32.3 when tree width is 10, then continuing to rise to 77.4 when tree width is 20, 85.9 when tree width is 30, and finally reaching 89.2 when tree width is 40.
